name: sexy-fantasy-elf-surrounded-by-figures
image_purpose: Cosplay showcase and creator-room social content

prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic fantasy elf cosplay portrait in a cozy anime and gaming fan bedroom, using generic collectible decor and safe costume coverage.
prompt.main_subject: One approved adult woman with fair skin, bright blue eyes, long wavy platinum-blonde hair, and realistic flesh-toned prosthetic elf ears. She wears an elegant opaque light green-and-gold fantasy gown with a secure high neckline, ornate gold corset detailing, emerald-green accents, gold arm cuffs, and flowing white detached sleeves. Her expression is confident and friendly, with a relaxed three-quarter pose.
prompt.composition_elements: Medium portrait at eye level, subject centered with bookshelves framing both sides. Fill the background with colorful manga volumes, generic fantasy and anime collectible figures, plush toys, and display boxes. Include soft pink-purple LED strips without readable brand logos.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft frontal ring light or LED-panel illumination with flattering facial highlights, pink-purple ambient room glow, subtle rim light on hair and shoulders, and a warm enthusiastic cosplay-showcase mood.
prompt.technical_specs: 50mm prime lens look, shallow depth of field, sharp face, ears, jewelry, and costume details, realistic fabric and metallic texture, high-detail RAW-photo finish, natural color grading.
